## What changed

- List a pull request's pages without downloading the base branch (#74)

## Other changes

None.

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.17.1#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.17.1
```
